name: aidropit
description: Connects your agent to aidrop.it — the remote MCP server that builds and runs what your agent writes: push the repository, build it, get a public address, attach a database, cache or queue.

interface.shortDescription: Your agent builds, aidrop.it runs it: deploy to a public address with a database, cache or queue.
interface.longDescription: aidrop.it hosts the applications your agent writes. Push the repository, and one service_build builds it and deploys it to a public address; attach a PostgreSQL database, a Valkey cache or a queue when the product needs one; read logs, roll back to an earlier image, and point your own domain at it — all from the conversation, over MCP with OAuth. No API key to paste, no dashboard step to finish by hand.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this repository to aidrop.it and give me the address.
Add a PostgreSQL database to my aidrop.it Service and wire it into the app.
Check why my aidrop.it Service is failing and fix it.
